statement: Fix l prime, E finite over Q_l, and a quasi-compact open immersion j:U→V on schemes where l is invertible. There exists a Context l E j [def-pur-completed-open-tensor-representative-data]. In particular, the two coefficient calculi use the canonical integral tensor models, their completion comparisons commute with actual adjunction units, and the all-input open reduction comparison restricts to completeOpen.r. The restriction/completion comparison has its actual-unit square. No ordinary tensor comparison gamma or representative tensor squares are asserted. Site and coefficient universes are independent.

proof.text: Apply canonicalIntegralCompletionModels separately to V and U. This fixes each integral closed presentation before constructing its ordinary/derived completion models, and supplies the exact tensorV/U equalities. Map the global-section units into all stalks.

Choose normalizedOpenSections and apply openSemilinearTensorModel to these fixed calculi. Retain its same operations, ordinary reductions, coefficients and all-input strictOpen. Apply the inverse-unit construction of IntegralOpenReductionComparison to this model, retaining its defining r equation as sameOpen. The construction uses completeness of extension, normalized reconstruction, the canonical restriction mate and the adjunction triangle identities; all these equations are proved in the local helper.

Apply normalizedCompletionRealization to each of the ordinary/derived models, using stalk invertibility. This supplies completionV/U and their actual-unit equations for the unchanged reduction/limit adjunctions.

Use only PrincipalKoszulStrictReplacement.coefficient_datum for the coefficient adic datum and its already singleton-oriented ideal equality. Apply OpenRoosRestriction.restrictionDescent to the very same operations to obtain restrictionCompletion and restrictionUnit. For openUnit, prove directly that the ordinary slice-extension unit is invertible: subterminality gives a unique direct-sum summand, restriction commutes with sheafification, and the normalized summand-unit formula identifies the actual unit. Compose with the coefficient equivalence. Invertibility passes degreewise to complexes and through the exact derived localization formula; every derived object is a localization image up to isomorphism. Take asIso of this actual derived unit and assemble Context.
